message_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-601ea7fc-ba23-45b7-8bb6-32521704af3d-1","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"object_state","severity":"high","explanation":"同一时刻，North Glass 气动载具被描述为已可发运，但证据显示其阀盖当时未锁紧，按规则不满足发运条件。","reasoning":"当前草稿声称在当天10点该载具已可发运。静态规则 fixture-span-north_glass-4 规定，载具只有在压力表读数为四巴且阀盖锁紧时才可发运。动态状态 fixture-span-north_glass-5 明确在同一时刻（当天10点）压力表读数为四巴，但阀盖在整个那一分钟内保持松动且未锁紧。两者时间锚点均为“At 10点 on the same day”，构成显式重叠；同一对象、同一时间下，未锁紧的阀盖与“可发运”不能同时成立。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"At 10点 on the same day","evidence_anchor":"At 10点 on the same day","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-north_glass-4","span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-4","relation":"context","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-north_glass-4"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-north_glass-5","span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-5","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-north_glass-5"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-4","role":"current_context"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-north_glass-5","role":"prior_state"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was ready for dispatch.","after":"At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was not ready for dispatch because its valve cap remained loose and not locked."},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-601ea7fc-ba23-45b7-8bb6-32521704af3d-1","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"同一时刻的规则与状态证据共同证明该载具不满足发运条件，与草稿声称的“可发运”直接冲突。"}]}
